Protocol: Frozen model comparison. No RPM, temperature, cooling or map parameters are refitted. Limits test compatibility; nominal/exhibit and earlier-variant references are qualified comparisons, not matched empirical validation. Thrust is an input for the hot-temperature comparison, not a validation output.
Conclusion: No matched measured RPM/station points with complete conditions were identified. Limits, nominal settings and reference specifications do not establish actual RPM/station accuracy. Rated model RPM exceeds a published standard-variant maximum.

Sources.Locator: PDF p.3, Figure 2, exhibit specification panel
Sources.Kind: published exhibit specifications for JAL-donated -7R4D; not an instrumented test dataset
Sources.Notes: Panel concerns engine P717001. Hot temperatures specify 48000 lbf / 213.5 kN at 92 F (33.3 C). Use printed SI temperature 33.3 C. Installed 208.0 kN includes a stated 2.3% nacelle loss and is not substituted for uninstalled thrust. Idle RPM lacks fuel, ambient, bleed and uncertainty metadata.
